zero3-read-early.title: Read Early and Often
relevant_sections: Reading with children approaching age three
Repetition and anticipation of familiar stories
zero3-read-early.scope_note: Discusses shared reading, repeating and predicting familiar stories; no controlled assessment of serialized TTS bedtime fiction.

cdc-three-milestones.title: Milestones by 3 Years
cdc-three-milestones.author_or_publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
cdc-three-milestones.scope_note: Population guidance; not an age-three comprehension requirement or individual assessment tool for this story.

aap-social-preschool-2024.title: Social Development in Preschoolers: Learning How to Share & Cooperate
aap-social-preschool-2024.scope_note: Discusses emerging preschool friendships and adult help; not evidence that a fictional hedgehog story increases empathy.

harvard-ef-guide-2014.title: Activities Guide: Enhancing and Practicing Executive Function Skills with Children from Infancy to Adolescence
harvard-ef-guide-2014.author_or_publisher: Center on the Developing Child at Harvard University
harvard-ef-guide-2014.scope_note: Guidance on supported playful activities. Does not report an experimental test of tilted lanterns or TTS narratives.

ucar-sunshine-shadows.scope_note: Explains shadow formation and changes in shadow length with solar angle. Does not evaluate a preschool fiction story or its developmental effects.

nps-natural-sounds-education.title: Education Resources — Natural Sounds
nps-natural-sounds-education.author_or_publisher: U.S. National Park Service, Natural Sounds and Night Skies Division
nps-natural-sounds-education.scope_note: Educational listening and soundscape activities. It does not establish benefits from the fictional listening book, this audio story, or any age-three treatment.

relevant_sections: Other calls produced by toads and frogs

aap-power-of-play-2018.title: The Power of Play: A Pediatric Role in Enhancing Development in Young Children
aap-power-of-play-2018.author_or_publisher: Michael Yogman, Andrew Garner, Jeffrey Hutchinson, Kathy Hirsh-Pasek, Roberta Michnick Golinkoff; American Academy of Pediatrics
relevant_sections: Social or Pretend Play Alone or With Others
aap-power-of-play-2018.scope_note: Clinical report (reaffirmed January 2025) synthesizing developmental play research. Does not test this fictional story series or listening outcomes; do not transfer broad findings about active play into specific claims about passive TTS listening.

umn-radishes-2024.title: Growing radishes in home gardens
umn-radishes-2024.author_or_publisher: Marissa Schuh and Jill MacKenzie, University of Minnesota Extension
relevant_sections: How to keep your radishes healthy and productive
umn-radishes-2024.scope_note: Reviewed 2024. Describes suitable outdoor planting, radish seedling emergence within ten days, cotyledons, and moisture needs. Does not prove that the fictional garden develops exactly this way or confer developmental gains on listeners.

umn-seed-starting-2026.title: Starting seeds indoors
umn-seed-starting-2026.scope_note: Reviewed 2026. Specifically covers indoor seed starts; used for general principles of labels, moisture, light and imperfect germination, not for site-specific outdoor planting advice. Outdoor radish claims use the separate radish source.
